name: DJ Paul
sources: Memphis Flyer — Q&A with DJ Paul of Three 6 Mafia — https://www.memphisflyer.com/CallingtheBluff/archives/2013/04/11/q-and-a-with-dj-paul-of-three-6-mafia
notes: Co-architect of the whole lane; a producer's model is his workflow, and his is documented end to end. The tempo spans both his eras — 62–72 half-time on the tapes and 74–84 in the crunk years, which is 124–168 straight, the widest band in this batch. Three parameters are his rather than the archetype's. (1) **Damaged fidelity is a parameter, not a mix note.** Four-track to 16-track reel with tape hiss and clipping left in gives `quantizeStrength` 0.76, `velocityVar` 0.28 and the largest `timingJitterMs` here — the "made in the basement feel" is timing and velocity spread. (2) The cowbell is the subdivision (`percs.densityPerBar` 6–10 at −1 dB across cowbell, clave and rim), and the clap sits *with* the snare on 3 rather than layered late. (3) The 808 is a long-decay pedal tone tied to the kick with **no portamento** — `slideProb` 0.02 and `glideProb` 0.01, the most static low end in this batch. Harmony is i drones and i–VI / i–♭II vamps, but from the late 2000s he adds written keyboard parts and "all of the orchestrated intros", so `voicing.topVoiceStepwise` is true and the register runs to 72: this model is allowed a voice-led line, which the tape-era models are not. `timbreHint` is `horror_organ` because horror-film scores are a documented source alongside the Willie Hutch / Diana Ross / Rick James soul loops. Arrangement is posse-cut architecture — 12–16 bar handoffs, more verses per structure, 8-bar chant hooks, and a high drop-out probability for the a cappella chant. ⚠ The research says the countermelody is absent; it is authored at the engine's floor (0.3, two styles) because a part that never varies saturates the variety gate — mute it first if the loop should stand alone. ⛔ **`chords.impliedByRiff` is set.** This model reached only 437 distinct harmonies in 1000 seeds, and every honest lever — chord duration, harmonic rhythm, voicing window — was already open. The reason is the record rather than the authoring: the harmony is stated by the drone rather than by a chord part, so there is one thing to voice. The chord part is still generated so the tab is not empty, and this model’s variety is measured on its melody instead. ⚠ If it ever grows a real progression, delete this flag. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 962 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary.
